description: Introducing the Sparta Meteor Boar Bristle Basting Brush - the perfect tool for any home cook or professional chef! The 2-inch wide brush head is perfect for evenly basting meats, poultry, and vegetables. The brush features boar bristles, which are heat-resistant and perfect for use with high-temperature foods. The projecting hook protects the handle from heat damage, making it safe and easy to use on the grill or in the oven. The molded plastic handle provides a comfortable grip, even when basting for extended periods of time. The predrilled notch in the handle allows for easy hanging and storage. This brush is perfect for home use or in a commercial kitchen. Its high-quality boar bristles and heat-resistant design make it ideal for basting meats, poultry, and vegetables. Ensure your food is evenly basted and full of flavor with the Sparta Meteor Boar Bristle Basting Brush. This essential tool is a must-have for any kitchen.
